create_UnifiedDataset: create a UnifiedDataset instance to load and tokenize multi-hop retrieval data from a JSONL file
create_FeverUnifiedDataset: create a FeverUnifiedDataset instance to load and tokenize FEVER claim verification data from a JSONL file
create_FeverSampler: create a FeverSampler to balance single and multi evidence samples during training with a configurable ratio
create_NQUnifiedDataset: create a NQUnifiedDataset instance to load and tokenize Natural Questions data with negative sampling support
run_unified_collate: run the unified_collate function to batch and pad tokenized samples from UnifiedDataset or FeverUnifiedDataset
